title: File converter
description: Connection to the file converter service that turns document files (pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, ...) into Markdown for the crawl.

file-converter.description: Identifier flag of the file-converter connection type

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the file converter service, e.g. http://converter:8000; the client appends /convert and /health

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: HTTP timeout per file; defaults to 300 seconds. Large PDFs take minutes
